analyses.title_sv: Ukraina: Sju mördade i Zaporizjzjia varav tre barn – oljeterminal i ryska Rostov bombad – Trump och USA ska finansiera ryska terrorbombningar via köp av rysk diesel, inför sanktioner mot krigstribunalen ICC i Haag
analyses.title_en: Ukraine: Seven murdered in Zaporizhzhya, including three children - oil terminal in Russian Rostov bombed - Trump and the US will finance Russian terrorist bombings through the purchase of Russian diesel, before sanctions against the war tribunal ICC in The Hague
analyses.summary_sv: Sju civila varav tre barn mördades i bombning mot storstaden Zaporizjzjia. Olje- och bränsleterminalen i ryska Rostov bombades av Ukraina och står i brand. USA:s fascistiske despot Trump meddelade igår att USA ska finansiera de ryska terrorbombningarna mot Ukraina via köp av rysk diesel, och fredssamtal mellan USA och Ukraina i Miami avbröts i förtid.
analyses.summary_en: Seven civilians, three of whom were children, were killed in the bombing of the large city of Zaporizhzhya. The oil and fuel terminal in Russian Rostov was bombed by Ukraine and is on fire. America's fascist despot Trump announced yesterday that the United States will finance the Russian terrorist bombings against Ukraine via the purchase of Russian diesel, and peace talks between the United States and Ukraine in Miami were canceled prematurely.
key_takeaways_sv: Sju civila varav tre barn mördades i bombning mot storstaden Zaporizjzjia.
Olje- och bränsleterminalen i ryska Rostov bombades av Ukraina och står i brand.
USA:s fascistiske despot Trump meddelade igår att USA ska finansiera de ryska terrorbombningarna mot Ukraina via köp av rysk diesel, och fredssamtal mellan USA och Ukraina i Miami avbröts i förtid.
key_takeaways_en: Seven civilians, three of whom were children, were killed in the bombing of the large city of Zaporizhzhya.
The oil and fuel terminal in Russian Rostov was bombed by Ukraine and is on fire.

America's fascist despot Trump announced yesterday that the United States will finance the Russian terrorist bombings against Ukraine via the purchase of Russian diesel, and peace talks between the United States and Ukraine in Miami were canceled prematurely.

President Zelenskyj kritiserar USA-regimens försök till ekonomiska uppgörelser med den ryska diktaturen efter att över 70 ukrainare mördats av Ryssland på två dygn.
